subject.title: 5.26 supervisor mode + dual-plist install: 30s EADDRINUSE loop + silent-fail unset order

question: Should OpenClaw change generated macOS launchd service behavior, doctor repair, or node service lifecycle for this dual-plist supervisor loop, or publish the docs-first recovery path while keeping runtime hardening separate?
rationale: The remaining fix affects generated service environment semantics and node LaunchAgent lifecycle for existing macOS installs, so automation should not choose the policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Land Docs-First Recovery
options.body: Land the open troubleshooting runbook for affected operators and keep runtime wrapper plus doctor/install hardening tracked here for a separately proven change.

options.title: Implement Runtime And Doctor Hardening
options.body: Update generated wrappers and doctor/install repair behavior now, with focused tests and live macOS upgrade proof for gateway-only and node-service hosts.

options.title: Document Only
options.body: Treat this as an operator recovery case and avoid changing launchd marker or node-service lifecycle behavior until a broader service model decision is made.

recommendation.title: Land Docs-First Recovery
recommendation.body: Land the open troubleshooting runbook for affected operators and keep runtime wrapper plus doctor/install hardening tracked here for a separately proven change.
